title: TI P4-11: move threat-intelligence.anth.us (and staging host) to the new app, with rollback
description:
## Goal
threat-intelligence.anth.us (and the staging host) is served by the new app, with a tested rollback to the old app. Brief downtime accepted (Q1).

## Context (FACT)
- Today: old app d3on1y5vlrxmam owns anth.us / prefix threat-intelligence / branch main (AVAILABLE); Route 53 zone Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73 has threat-intelligence.anth.us CNAME (TTL 500) to a CloudFront domain managed by Amplify. Another app (d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, Anth.us production) also holds anth.us associations: do not touch it, and do not let the staging name collide with its staging.anth.us.
- A domain/prefix can be served by one app at a time: delete the old association first, then create the new one (Pilobol.us prep comment: delete-domain-association on the old app, deploy the stack to add the domains, wait for AVAILABLE).
- Template support from P4-05 (the form chosen there).
- Cognito callbacks: PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS in site.json must list https://threat-intelligence.anth.us/ (and the staging origin); Google's console lists only the Cognito origin (unchanged, nothing to edit there).

## Exact steps
1. Prereqs: P4-09 and P4-10 done, P4-05 template published, a final baseline re-capture of the live OLD site (P4-01 script) so rollback and parity are provable, editing frozen.
2. site.json: hostedZoneId Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73, cms.domainName per P4-05, cms.stagingDomainName per Q8, add the origins to PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS; PR and merge; cdk diff reviewed with Ryan.
3. Ryan yes, then in this order: aws amplify delete-domain-association --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --domain-name anth.us; cdk deploy the site stack (creates Domain and StagingDomain); wait until both domain associations are AVAILABLE (get-domain-association); confirm Route 53 records point to the new app's CloudFront distribution.
4. Probes against the public host: edition page, 18 articles, /newsroom, a missing path returns 404 with the custom page, Cognito sign-in round trip from the public host, staging host sign-in redirect, response headers (no accidental noindex on production), and the P4-01 text comparison.
5. Rollback (rehearsed on paper, executed only if probes fail): delete the new domain associations (stack update reverting site.json), then aws amplify create-domain-association --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --domain-name anth.us --no-enable-auto-sub-domain --sub-domain-settings prefix=threat-intelligence,branchName=main. The old app still serves its last build (auto build was disabled in P4-04).

## Acceptance checks
- https://threat-intelligence.anth.us serves from the new app (the CloudFront distribution in the DNS answer and the Amplify job id differ from the old app), text equals the baseline for all public routes, sign-in works, Anth.us app and its domains unchanged (list-domain-associations for d2hbn1ig6nqyhy before and after identical).
- Downtime measured and recorded.

## Rollback
As step 5.

## Risks
Certificate issuance and DNS propagation (minutes, CNAME TTL 500 s); an Amplify rule that refuses a prefix on a root owned by another app: if so, the template ticket P4-05 needs the other form, found out here, hence the old association is recreated immediately.

## Needs Ryan
Yes: go/no-go, the delete-domain-association and stack deploy, and sign-in checks.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.

- apex: A ALIAS d3g02spttqf8mz.cloudfront.net (Anth.us prod); www CNAME TTL500 same target; MX 300 `0 mx1.mailchannels.net` (apex and mail.anth.us); TXT 300 openai-domain-verification (apex); 3 DKIM CNAMEs (SES, TTL60); 6dxbqd5bbdmg CNAME googlehosted (TTL60); NS/SOA.

## 3. Live behavior (curl/openssl, 2026-10-07 evening)

- anth.us and www.anth.us: HTTP/2 200 server AmazonS3 via CloudFront; cert Amazon RSA 2048 S18, serial 4011E19937BAEFB5718712CAE5777777, 2026-10-04..2027-04-20, SAN *.anth.us, anth.us. NOTE a DIFFERENT cert than TI's: certs are per association (per app), not one shared object.

## 4. ANTH.US PRODUCTION BASELINE (capture NOW; GET, body sha256)
- https://anth.us/  200 30811 B  sha256 95aa2bea625590305b23780fb2005a8b1a15ef742cbd523cbcde402e10331174 (shasum sha1 ae49d19beb09ede7...)
- https://www.anth.us/  200 30811 B  identical hash
- https://anth.us/about/  200 23200 B  sha256 c3b45f585855a9ae181c25377b291ae9c9cfc12060def6aef845b810e537607c (www identical)
- https://anth.us/articles/  200 29270 B  sha256 3ac5c9d0009d99ac36c2cfbc95cfa28653430edc906e8e537fa2878830a52973
- https://anth.us/robots.txt 200 66 B sha1-prefix 2ed083572533da22
- cert serial 4011E19937BAEFB5718712CAE5777777, notAfter 2027-04-20 17:32:32Z (issuer Amazon RSA 2048 S18). Re-run: `curl -s URL | shasum -a 256` and `echo | openssl s_client -connect anth.us:443 -servername anth.us 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -serial -enddate`.
- Amplify state to diff: `aws amplify get-domain-association --app-id d2hbn1ig6nqyhy --domain-name anth.us` (AVAILABLE, subs ''->main, www->main, autoSub false, updateStatus null); zone record snapshot: `aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73` (save to a file before, diff after).

## 5. KEY RISK ANALYSIS: can deleting the OLD association disturb Anth.us production? Verdict: NO (evidence)
a) Many apps already hold anth.us together (6 now). Create of a second/third app's association for the same root WORKS if the prefixes differ (CloudTrail: Apricity, Primus, Babulus, Tactus, Cyclotron all created beside production). It FAILS (BadRequestException, 2026-09-30 10:15:14 and 10:15:44, app d164nik0r91btj) when the SAME prefix (apex '') is held by another app. So the same prefix must be released first: delete the OLD association before the CFN Domain create (as the ticket says).
b) What Amplify does on DeleteDomainAssociation (CloudTrail ChangeResourceRecordSets by amplify.amazonaws.com): it DELETEs only that association's own sub-domain records. Examples: 2026-10-07 17:21:14 delete of d27186ecn0u5l6 anth.us -> DELETE cyclotron.anth.us CNAME only; 2026-10-04 13:32:13 delete of d1ffh6ny5rvtl anth.us -> DELETE anth.us A + www CNAME only; 10-04 17:44:53 Primus update -> DELETE plexus CNAME only. It NEVER deleted the shared `_61eb...` validation CNAME: across 10 prior anth.us DeleteDomainAssociation calls (d1ffh6ny5rvtl x3, d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, d164nik0r91btj, d39vkkujb9n1f6, d27186ecn0u5l6) the record is still present; Amplify only UPSERTs it on CREATE (same value, no-op for other apps).
c) Certificates are per association (TI serial 0FE6... vs production serial 4011..., different notBefore/notAfter), and the apex/www CloudFront (d3g02spttqf8mz) is production's own distribution. Deleting TI's association deletes TI's cert/distribution only. The production cert was itself issued 2026-10-04 right after d1ffh6ny5rvtl's association was deleted and while other apps' associations remained: the same operation sequence already ran against live production once without incident.
d) Edit vs delete (PHASE A decision): the old association has exactly ONE subdomain (threat-intelligence->main). `update-domain-association` removing it would leave zero subdomains (not a state any other app holds; behaviour with an empty list unproven) and cannot keep "other settings" (there are none). Pick DELETE of d3on1y5vlrxmam anth.us: it is the proven path (identical to the 10 prior deletes, the pilobol/Plexus precedent, ticket step 3). An update would only be needed to preserve other prefixes; none exist. Production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy is never an argument of any command in the plan.
e) Residual risks: (i) the `_61eb` CNAME is not touched by delete; if it were ever removed, ACM managed renewal (production cert expires 2027-04-20, renewal ~Feb 2027) would need it re-UPSERTed (it is re-UPSERTed by any create): detect with the Route 53 diff and re-run nothing destructive; (ii) the CFN Domain create issues a NEW managed cert for the TI association (minutes) and UPSERTs `_61eb` + threat-intelligence CNAME; (iii) CloudFormation Domain create when the prefix is still held by the old app returns BadRequest => stack UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE: Domain never created, nothing else changes (rollback only reverts the stack, no association touched). (iv) Do NOT use enableAutoSubDomain: template CfnDomain omits it (default false), matching production's false.
GO/NO-GO for Anth.us: GO, risk very low, conditional on the pre/post checks below being identical.

## 6. Template behaviour (origin/develop lib/amplify-app-shell.ts, #143/#146/#151/#161)
With cms.domainName anth.us + domainPrefix + stagingDomainPrefix + staging true: synth emits ONE AWS::Amplify::Domain "Domain" (DomainName anth.us, SubDomainSettings: main->threat-intelligence, staging->threat-intelligence-staging; no EnableAutoSubDomain; no StagingDomain resource in shared-root mode; DependsOn production + staging Branch), one CfnBranch "StagingBranch" (BETA, SITE_ENV staging, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE drafts, own staging build spec, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL https://threat-intelligence-staging.anth.us), PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS from site.json verbatim (default amplifyapp URLs no longer appended since domainName set). The template writes no Route 53 records (Amplify does, same account, zone Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73). Gap: the Domain depends on the staging Branch existing in Amplify, which the stack creates, but Amplify build of staging needs the Git `staging` ref (below). 

## 7. PLAN (every step needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat; none executed)
Pre-flight (read-only): `export AWS_PROFILE=legacy AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1; aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account`; save before-state:
 `aws amplify get-domain-association --app-id d2hbn1ig6nqyhy --domain-name anth.us > /tmp/ti-before-prod-assoc.json`; `aws amplify get-domain-association --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --domain-name anth.us > /tmp/ti-before-old-assoc.json`; `aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73 > /tmp/ti-before-zone.json`; repeat the section 4 hash/cert capture; take a fresh baseline of the OLD site (P4-01 script) and freeze edits (Q9).
PHASE A (no change to production; ordering): 
 A0 Ensure the Git `staging` branch exists BEFORE the Domain: `git clone` a fresh clone of AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence in /Users/home/Projects/TI-p411, `git push origin main:refs/heads/staging` (new branch only; never main). Verify `git ls-remote --heads origin staging`. (Amplify branch `staging` is created by the CDK; with the Git ref present its first build can run once the console connect picks it up: connect staging in the console after the stack update (docs/site-hosting.md: console connect deletes branches/env vars; re-apply by stack update marker PAPYRUS_STACK_REAPPLY=1 as done for main).)
 A1 Dry-run the full stack WITHOUT deploy: fresh clone of main, `cd infra && npx papyrus-infra synth` (full infra/site.json) then `AWS_PROFILE=legacy npx aws-cdk@2 diff --app cdk.out AmplifyAppShell-threat-intelligence`. Expected: ADD AWS::Amplify::Branch StagingBranch; ADD AWS::Amplify::Domain Domain (anth.us, two subdomain settings, appId dzefa11i80jyq); MODIFY Branch main PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS (both full hosts, default amplifyapp URLs dropped) only; NO replace/delete; NO resources named for d2hbn1ig6nqyhy, no Route53 records, no MX/TXT, no role changes. Full site.json vs domain-free copy: ADD `hostedZoneId: "Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73"`, ADD cms.domainName "anth.us", cms.domainPrefix "threat-intelligence", cms.stagingDomainPrefix "threat-intelligence-staging"; REMOVE cms.staging:false (or set true); PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS = `http://localhost:3001/,https://threat-intelligence.anth.us/,https://threat-intelligence-staging.anth.us/`. Cognito callbacks on the new pool already include both hosts (verify: `aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client` on the new pool, CallbackURLs names only/hosts). Google needs NO change: only the Cognito domain `papyrus-threat-intelligence.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com` origin and `/oauth2/idpresponse` redirect (client project 778847915037), independent of the site host.
PHASE B (Ryan go; downtime window about 5 to 15 min):
 B1 Delete the old association (the one downtime step): `aws amplify delete-domain-association --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --domain-name anth.us`. Verify at once: `aws amplify list-domain-associations --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam`; `aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z02552332GG6AM25SFP73 > /tmp/ti-after-b1.json` and diff vs before: ONLY threat-intelligence.anth.us CNAME gone; `_61eb...`, apex, www, MX, TXT, DKIM unchanged; production hashes unchanged.
 B2 Deploy (same step window): `cd infra && AWS_PROFILE=legacy npx aws-cdk@2 deploy AmplifyAppShell-threat-intelligence --app cdk.out --require-approval broadening`. Wait: `aws amplify get-domain-association --app-id dzefa11i80jyq --domain-name anth.us --query 'domainAssociation.[domainStatus,subDomains[].[subDomainSetting.prefix,verified]]'` until AVAILABLE and both verified; `dig +short CNAME threat-intelligence.anth.us` -> new CloudFront; `...-staging.anth.us` -> CloudFront.
 B3 Console (Ryan): connect the `staging` Git branch to dzefa11i80jyq; then repair env vars on both branches via stack update with PAPYRUS_STACK_REAPPLY=1 then without (as P4-06); start the staging job: `aws amplify start-job --app-id dzefa11i80jyq --branch-name staging --job-type RELEASE`; poll `get-job`.
 B4 Verify: curl -sI both hosts 200/307 (valid cert, issuer Amazon, SAN includes the host: `echo | openssl s_client -connect HOST:443 -servername HOST | openssl x509 -noout -issuer -serial -enddate -ext subjectAltName`); edition page, 18 articles, /newsroom, 404 page, videos play (mp4 range requests), /robots.txt 404; text-hash and 120-screenshot baseline re-run on the new host vs P4-01; Cognito sign-in round trip from the public host; cert not the old serial 0FE6E6DA...; staging: anonymous GET redirects to /newsroom (no loop; the #163-class gate for a Pretext site: confirm with `node scripts/check-staging-guards.mjs https://threat-intelligence-staging.anth.us staging`), robots Disallow + noindex + STAGING banner, editor sees a draft that is 404 on production, non-editor 403; production branch has no staging-only vars (names). 
 B5 Anth.us proof (before/after identical): section 4 hashes for anth.us, www, /about/, /articles/; cert serial 4011E199... and notAfter 2027-04-20; `get-domain-association` for d2hbn1ig6nqyhy diff empty; Route 53 diff vs /tmp/ti-before-zone.json = only threat-intelligence CNAME changed/added, threat-intelligence-staging CNAME added, no MX/TXT/DKIM/apex/www/_61eb change; `list-domain-associations` for the other four anth.us apps unchanged.
 B6 Record downtime (timestamps of B1 and first 200 on the new host).
ROLLBACK (if B4 fails): (1) revert site.json domain fields in the TI repo (domain-free copy), `cdk deploy` (deletes the Domain: removes only threat-intelligence and staging CNAMEs) or, if CFN is stuck, `aws amplify delete-domain-association --app-id dzefa11i80jyq --domain-name anth.us`; (2) `aws amplify create-domain-association --app-id d3on1y5vlrxmam --domain-name anth.us --no-enable-auto-sub-domain --sub-domain-settings prefix=threat-intelligence,branchName=main`; wait AVAILABLE; old app still holds its last build (auto build off). Verify old host serves 200 and the old sha256 `c202b9e0...` for /2026/july/04, and section 4 hashes unchanged. If B2 itself fails at the Domain create: stack rolls back to UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE with no Domain; just run rollback step (2) immediately.
PHASE C (separate ticket P4-12, after 2 weeks sign-off): retire old app, backend, secrets; no action here.
P4-10 ordering: P4-10 (staging) is satisfied by the staging branch and domain in Phase B; before P4-11 the staging build can run on https://staging.dzefa11i80jyq.amplifyapp.com only if the stack is updated with cms.staging true and no domain fields (domain-free variant, no Domain created, zero risk to anth.us); the explicit staging host is only created at B2.

## 8. Ryan by hand / approvals
Explicit yes for: B1 delete-domain-association, B2 cdk deploy (and A1 diff review), push of Git `staging`, console connect of the staging branch (B3), start-job, sign-in checks as editor and non-editor, the downtime window and go/no-go, rollback if needed. Google console: nothing to change (Cognito domain origin/redirect on client project 778847915037 do not depend on the host). No emails/secrets in this plan. Nothing in the Route 53 console.
Open caveat: staging gate on a Pretext (non-root-newsroom) site is verified only by the guard script after the first staging build; if the redirect loops, stop before sign-off, not a cutover blocker for production.
